experiment: batch-1 decode, overlap scheduling vs plain loop vs mlx-lm vs hand-pipelined prototype
metric: ms_per_token = median wall time of one decode step (one new token) within a run. Engine arms: 3 runs per process after one unmeasured warm-up run, each a fresh engine on the same loaded model; mlx-lm: median over generate_step yields after the first; mj arms: median Engine.step() after the prefill step. Prototype (scratchpad pipe_proto.py, bypasses the scheduler, fixed block table): sync, pipelined, sync, pipelined after one warm-up, median of steps 3+
order: r1: mlx-lm, mj_plain, mj_overlap, prototype; r2: prototype, mj_overlap, mj_plain, mlx-lm; one process per arm
energy: not measured in this run (direct timing only); see the mlx_bench --overlap ABAB
tokens_note: prototype sync vs pipelined gave identical tokens; mj overlap vs plain token identity is covered by tests/mlx/test_overlap.py, not checked in this timing run
